body:
The changes are not displaying correctly, sometimes not any at all. 

The following are all notes from a previous task:

Changes
The Changes tab now reads like a code outline instead of showing the server's order.

Changes are grouped by module, with a heading per group and the symbols listed under it.
Source modules come first and *_test modules last, so the behaviour change comes before its tests.
Symbols are alphabetical inside each module.
For a task that covers several projects, the project is part of the heading (b · app) and projects are ordered first.
Added a Change(project, module, name) type. Task.changes is now a list of these, and task_decoder splits each name at the last .. It no longer builds the "p: name" string.
Added change_groups(changes, multi_project), a pure function that sorts and groups. detail renders its result. The tab title still shows the total count.
Verification
Updated task_across_projects_test for the new Change type.
Added change_groups_test, which uses unordered input across source and test modules and checks the ordering and the cross-project heading.
Ran the affected tests: 18 passed, no failures. Seven other tests were skipped because the change doesn't reach them, and I didn't run test --all.
I did not look at how the page renders the new h4 and section markup, so it may need CSS styling.
Not done
Showing whether a change was added, changed or removed would need the Rust server in solace-cli to send that, and it isn't in this task's scope.
title: Fix Changes Display
